0022600198.text: The Timberwolves (7-3, 3-1 at home) host the Utah Jazz (1-8) in their 11th game of the season, with Minnesota 2nd in the Northwest, 1 game back, riding a three-game winning streak while Utah has lost seven straight. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery), who is averaging 33.3 points this season, and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), while Joan Beringer is day-to-day with a fracture and a game-time decision. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) and Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), with Keyonte George (illness) and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain) day-to-day and game-time decisions; the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Minnesota won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 147-111 win in Minneapolis on March 18, 2026.
